summary: Live waitlist join, check-in, and cancel refuse unless --yes (or MCP yes=true); --dry-run previews without POSTing.
reason: Sniffed waitlist POSTs mutate guest state. Default CLI/MCP calls must not join, check in, or cancel a live list.
validated_outcome: CLI submit/cancel/checkin without --yes/--dry-run refuse; --dry-run does not POST; --yes POSTs. MCP tools are destructive and gated the same way.
